findings.suggested_fix: Book deterministic Scheduled, Completed, No-show and latest-starting Cancelled appointments for one doctor and day. Assert that exactly the three non-cancelled ids are returned (this also covers S-4 AC2).
findings.text: The NOT_CANCELLED API test uses patient 1. The fixture books no appointments, and in this suite patient 1 has only Cancelled appt 1 plus maybe the racy APT-4 Tuesday slot. No Completed or No-show row is checked (S-4 AC1), and the test passes when zero rows come back.

findings.suggested_fix: Add an API test. Book appointments for a doctor today, including one at 00:30 Asia/Kolkata and one Cancelled. Assert that GET /api/appointments with doctorId, status=NOT_CANCELLED and from=to=today has a total equal to the doctors list's today_count.
findings.text: REQ-10 has no test, and ut.md leaves it out of trace. The change relies on the list using the Today count's rule, yet no test checks that the NOT_CANCELLED list for today equals today_count, including the 00:30 local-time edge.

cites.quote: then the chooser shows that Inactive doctor's name

findings.suggested_fix: Route /api/doctors/:id to the matching doctor in the mock, and add a test for '/appointments?doctorId=2' that expects LABEL_2.
findings.text: S-1 AC4 (an Inactive doctor opened from a link shows its name) is not tested. The fetch mock answers only /api/doctors/1 with a doctor, so /api/doctors/2 would get the list body.

findings.suggested_fix: Assert that the chooser area shows no bare id, for example that no element's exact text is '1'.
findings.text: The REQ-1 'not the id' assertion looks for the text 'doctorId', not the id value, so it would not catch the raw id 1 being shown.

findings.text: The Clear All test covers only S-3 AC2 (status and dates). AC1 (doctor, patient, status and dates all set) is not tested, yet ut.md says the test clears every filter.

findings.suggested_fix: Move the kept parameters into a constant or a helper.
findings.text: The kept-filter assertion loop appears twice in the REQ-4/REQ-5/REQ-14 test (duplicate setup code).

rubric_items.reason: Service, repo and AppointmentsPage get tests, but nothing tests REQ-10 (Today link list equals the count, including the Asia/Kolkata midnight edge). Nothing tests the Inactive doctor opened from a link, or Completed and No-show being included.
Most assertions check URLs, labels and status codes. The NOT_CANCELLED API test can pass with zero rows, and the REQ-1 'id not shown' check looks for the text 'doctorId', not the id.
There is an API 400 test for an unknown status. Missing: the S-4 AC2 edge (Cancelled is the latest-starting appointment), the S-5 AC2 timezone edge and the S-1 AC4 Inactive-from-link case.
Vitest+Supertest and Vitest+Testing Library in the existing locations, with HMS-8 REQ-n names, as the strategy says. Minor: the kept-filter loop is duplicated.
No test or coverage numbers are stated. The artifact defers to the verifier, and checks.json shows coverage skipped (exit 78).
